description: An object which enables fine-grained traversal and precise data selection from structured data

context.description: A valid Runtime Expression which MUST evaluate to structured data (e.g., `$response.body`), and sets the context for the selector to be applied on

selector.description: A selector expression (e.g., `$.items[0].id`, `/Envelope/Item`) in the form of JSONPath expression, XPath expression, or JSON Pointer expression

type.description: The selector expression type to use (e.g., `jsonpath`, `xpath`, or `jsonpointer`) or an Expression Type Object for older version support
